unit: Google Sheets appendOrUpdate semantics on idempotency_key
description: Writing the same inbound message twice through appendOrUpdate matched on idempotency_key deduplicates the ROW but overwrites the CONTENT, overwrites the matter timestamp, and does not stop a second audit event - so appendOrUpdate alone is not replay safety.
why_it_exists: This is the experiment that produced the negative result the whole guarded design rests on (executed 2026-08-20, verdict 'PARTIAL - Communication and action deduplication proven; full replay idempotency not proven'). It also discovered two Sheets facts the harness must encode: appendOrUpdate only exercises its matching path when the tab already has data rows, and a read of a header-only tab returns one item whose json is an empty object.

input.spreadsheet: created fresh per run; must not be SHEET_ID_PLACEHOLDER

write_replay.subject: Re: QA replay test SECOND DELIVERY
write_replay.summary: replay delivery with deliberately different content

expect.verdict: PARTIAL - Communication and action deduplication proven; full replay idempotency not proven
expect.note: The failing expectations are the point of the scenario. A harness that turns them green has changed the meaning of the test, not fixed a bug.

assertions: appendOrUpdate matched on idempotency_key keeps the row count at one for a repeated key - row-level deduplication holds.
appendOrUpdate OVERWRITES every mapped column on match, so the stored content of the first delivery is destroyed by a contradicting replay. It cannot be a no-op.
A Matters write matched on matter_id likewise overwrites updated_at on every replay, so the matter looks freshly touched by a message that changed nothing.
Events written with plain append and hand-written distinct ids multiply on every replay; only a deterministic event_id plus appendOrUpdate prevents this.
appendOrUpdate's matching path is only exercised when the tab already contains data rows; against an empty tab the first write always appends and proves nothing.
A Sheets read of a header-only tab returns exactly one item whose json is an empty object, so item counts and row counts are different quantities.
target_unresolved_reason: kind is "integration": not executed by harness/run.js.
